justification: Data-only insert script, single file, follows established insert pattern. No frontend changes, no schema changes.

pre_impl.existing_data: dcp_setback_controls table — 999 existing rows, 0 existing private_open_space rows
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If lga values don't match existing lga values in table, rows insert but won't join to frontend queries. Mitigated: all lga values taken from existing DISTINCT lga list.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New rows only — INSERT with dedup check (SELECT before INSERT). No UPDATE on existing rows.
pre_impl.frontend_type: N/A — private_open_space already registered in CONTROL_CATEGORIES (Phase 1)
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: N/A — data appears in existing structured controls UI automatically

functions.name: main
functions.input: POS_ROWS list (43 dicts) + command line args (--dry-run)

values.if_missing: INSERT would fail on NOT NULL constraint
INSERT would fail on NOT NULL constraint

queries.purpose: Dedup check — prevent duplicate POS rows for same lga+dev_type+condition
queries.where_clause: WHERE lga = %s AND control_type = 'private_open_space' AND dev_type = %s AND condition = %s AND is_current = TRUE
queries.if_zero: Proceeds with INSERT — correct behavior for first run
queries.if_wrong: False positive dup detection would skip valid insert; mitigated by matching on condition string which is unique per row
Wrong values would be stored; mitigated by hardcoded data verified against DCP provision text

break_it.scenario: Run script twice — duplicate rows inserted
break_it.how: insert_private_open_space.py:461 — dedup SELECT checks lga+control_type+dev_type+condition before INSERT
break_it.repro: python scripts/insert_private_open_space.py && python scripts/insert_private_open_space.py — second run should show 43 skipped, 0 inserted

break_it.scenario: applicability value doesn't match CHECK constraint
break_it.what_happens: psycopg2.errors.CheckViolation — entire transaction fails, no rows inserted
break_it.how: insert_private_open_space.py:481 — only uses 'development_specific' or 'universal_residential', both in CHECK constraint enum
break_it.repro: grep -n applicability insert_private_open_space.py — verify only valid enum values

break_it.scenario: Wrong value_min for a council (e.g. Hornsby 16m2 should be 24m2)
break_it.what_happens: Users see incorrect POS requirement — could under/overestimate feasibility
break_it.how: All verified values cross-checked against regulatory_provisions text; unverified councils marked needs_review=TRUE with review_reason='standard_pattern_assumed'
break_it.repro: SELECT lga, value_min, needs_review FROM dcp_setback_controls WHERE control_type = 'private_open_space' AND is_current = TRUE ORDER BY lga

post_merge.manual_verify: Check /api/dcp/structured-controls for any council — private_open_space should appear in Open Space category
